scripts.build:wasm: test "$(wasm-bindgen --version)" = "wasm-bindgen 0.2.129" && cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p schemra-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/lib/generated ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/schemra_wasm.wasm && sed -i '1i// @ts-nocheck' src/lib/generated/schemra_wasm.js
scripts.check: bun run build:wasm && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
